F1.quote: Contingent singularity (Lee Sharks, #1637): A historical threshold at which the material machinery that makes symbolic difference operable changes the viability of further dialectical difference, either toward terminal closure or durable non-finality.
F1.claim: the registry page glosses the concept, attributed to Lee Sharks and #1637
F1.lineage: the registry's concept gloss (B1, B2, B3 carry it identically)

F2.quote: THE DATASET CARD COMPOSES THE WORK: at the exact-phrase title, the Overview is built from the Hugging Face card's 'minimal faithful summary' and keeps The Final Time's direction — singularity as the threshold in whether contradiction can become a materially reproducible outside, with terminal closure and terminal reflexivity held apart.
F2.claim: the 27 September Overview was built from the dataset card and kept the paper's direction
F2.lineage: B1, the record of 2026-09-27 (Google AI Overview)

F3.quote: The Final Time: Contingent Singularity and the Viability of the Next Dialectical Turn is an academic or theoretical paper deposited on platforms like Alexanarch.
F3.claim: the composition recorded: an academic or theoretical paper deposited on platforms like Alexanarch
F3.lineage: B1, the record of 2026-09-27 (Google AI Overview)

F4.quote: The text redefines a "singularity" not through the traditional lens of physics, but through historical and dialectical systems. It explores the threshold where systemic contradictions can or cannot achieve a "materially reproducible outside".
F4.claim: the composition recorded: the singularity redefined through historical and dialectical systems; the threshold of a materially reproducible outside
F4.lineage: B1, the record of 2026-09-27 (Google AI Overview)

F5.quote: Representation vs. Reproduction: The paper establishes this as its master distinction, evaluating independent historical relations.
F5.claim: the composition recorded: representation against reproduction as the master distinction
F5.lineage: B1, the record of 2026-09-27 (Google AI Overview)

F6.quote: Entropic Narrowing: It posits that as a system evolves, subsequent "turns" inherit a narrowing, less viable state space.
F6.claim: the composition recorded: entropic narrowing of the state space across turns
F6.lineage: B1, the record of 2026-09-27 (Google AI Overview)

F7.quote: Durable Exteriority: It argues that critique or alternative positions require specific material conditions to maintain a lasting, independent standing (exteriority).
F7.claim: the composition recorded: durable exteriority requires material conditions
F7.lineage: B1, the record of 2026-09-27 (Google AI Overview)

F8.quote: Closure: A state where no rival or outside force retains a viable path to durable standing.
F8.lineage: B1, the record of 2026-09-27 (Google AI Overview)

F9.quote: Reflexivity: A state where an order becomes durable without entirely sealing off the possibility of its own future negation.
F9.lineage: B1, the record of 2026-09-27 (Google AI Overview)
